prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: mut-bigN-08
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): 1be8b3ad436f7e95
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Loopback send 0xa5 never produces a received byte, reg_dat_do stays ~0 instead of 0xa5, causing uart timeout and tohost FAIL 0xdead. Root cause in excerpt is reg recv_state declared as [3:1] with no bit0, so states 1-10 are truncated/aliased and receive-complete is unreachable. Thus recv_buf_valid never asserts.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash 1be8b3ad436f7e95 in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
